_meta.derivation: common.issuer = manifest issuer = wamason-attacker.com, a domain the attacker legitimately controls: com signs its DS, so DNSSEC validates _tessera-v1.<issuer> (owner rebuilt from the signed issuer, P:549-550) and the TXT names the attacker's keys. The attacker also holds the repository key, so the commit verifies under the configured entry for D. Only the pinned-D gate fails: row 8.1 INVALID / ISSUER_NOT_PINNED (P:704-708). Under M2 (P:727-731) the git condition may also be read as unmet for D = common.issuer; that row is UNVERIFIABLE at worst and 8.1's INVALID is reported either way.

isolation.attacker_holds: its own domain's DNS and the repository key
